title: Stop dragging windows around on Windows 11
caption:
Stop dragging windows around on Windows 11 🪟

Snap two apps side by side in one second:
✅ Press Windows + Z
✅ Pick a layout, then pick a spot
✅ Click another app to fill the gap
✅ Not working? Settings > System > Multitasking > turn on Snap windows

Do you use Snap layouts or still drag windows? 👇
